title: Vision-based fire management system using autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles: a comprehensive survey
core_idea: This survey critically examines recent advancements in vision-based fire management enabled by autonomous UAVs, focusing on how state-of-the-art deep learning models (e.g., CNNs, attention mechanisms, YOLO variants, GANs, transformers) improve real-time fire detection, classification and segmentation; it also reviews available datasets, highlights practical challenges (data imbalance, privacy, real-time limits), and outlines future directions such as multimodal sensor fusion, lightweight architectures for UAV deployment, and vision-language models.
tldr: A concise survey of deep learning–driven, vision-based UAV solutions for fire detection, monitoring and response, summarizing architectures, datasets, key challenges and promising future directions without reporting experimental results.
